{{Top|leg}}
'''Remote computer links''' were devices that could be installed on [[Droid/Legends|droids]]. They were communications hardware that allowed the droid to access data or receive new instructions. [[Veril Line Systems/Legends|Veril Line Systems]] [[V5-T transport droid]]s could be fitted with remote computer links to access data regarding traffic conditions and to relay new orders.
